applicableAreas: Buildings 1, 2, and 8 (western frontage near Valley View Road)
findings.comment: Overhead utility lines are shown along Valley View Road (western boundary) adjacent to Buildings 1, 2, and 8. Site plan shows building locations in plan view only. No building elevation sheets with surveyed overhead conductor elevations are provided. No dimensions showing vertical clearances from building faces to overhead conductors are documented. Cannot verify that the required 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance is maintained without surveyed conductor elevation data and building elevation sheets with clearance dimensions.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1, 2, 8 (western frontage) and potential transmission structures
findings.comment: No building elevation sheets have been provided. Surveyed elevations and locations of overhead conductors are not included on any submitted building elevation documentation. Overhead electric lines are shown in plan view on Sheets 4, 9, and 21, but no elevation data or vertical clearance dimensions are provided to demonstrate compliance with clearance requirements.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1, 2, 8; potential building projections; western and southern boundaries
findings.comment: Site plan and electrical design plan show building footprints and overhead utility lines in plan view only. No section or elevation views with dimension lines from outer electric conductor to outermost edges of buildings and building projections are provided. Cannot verify clearances from conductor to building faces without these section exhibits.

applicableAreas: Driveway access points from Valley View Road (western entrance)
findings.comment: Driveways from Valley View Road pass directly beneath overhead electric lines shown on existing conditions survey and site plan. Grading plan shows finished driveway grades but no section views or profile exhibits document vertical clearances from driveway surface to the lowest point of overhead electric conductors. No mid-span clearance survey data from a registered surveyor is provided. Minimum 16-foot vertical clearance (or 18 feet with truck traffic) cannot be verified without mid-span clearance documentation.

Site plans show overhead electric lines and utility poles but do not include any dimension annotations showing clearances. No clearance dimensions are shown from outside conductor to buildings, driveways, sidewalks, or other site features. General notes on Sheet 3 reference compliance with clearance requirements but no specific dimensions on plans verify that clearances are measured from the outside conductor location rather than from pole centerline. Add detailed dimension lines and clearance measurements originating at the actual conductor location (not pole center) to all affected plan views and section views.

applicableAreas: Driveway locations beneath overhead lines; areas within potential vertical clearance distance of overhead conductors
findings.comment: Driveways are shown crossing beneath overhead electric lines, but driveway grades relative to overhead conductor heights cannot be evaluated from available site plan data. No survey by registered surveyor showing pole locations, conductor elevations, or mid-span clearances has been provided. Vertical clearance from proposed driveway grades to overhead electric facilities appears potentially insufficient based on benchmark elevations and building FFEs shown on plans, but cannot be verified without professional surveyor documentation of conductor locations and mid-span clearances.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary; areas within 10-50 feet of overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Landscape plan Sheet 31 shows mitigation trees (marked 'M') planted along the southern boundary directly adjacent to or within close proximity to overhead electric line marked '- OHE -'. Proposed shade trees consist of Cedar Elm (10 trees) and Live Oak (2 trees). Plant schedule specifies minimum 4-caliper cedar elm and live oak trees. Cannot verify from submitted documents whether Cedar Elm and Live Oak are marked as utility-compatible (UC) in ECM Appendix F. Additionally, lateral distances from tree planting locations to the overhead conductor centerline are not dimensioned on the landscape plan; visual analysis suggests trees are within 10-15 feet of the overhead line. Provide: (1) verification that proposed tree species are ECM Appendix F trees marked as utility-compatible (UC), and (2) dimensioned clearance measurements on landscape plan showing lateral distance from each tree location to outside conductor of overhead electric line to confirm 10-foot minimum distance for distribution conductors or 50-foot minimum distance for transmission conductors per UCM § 1.10.10.4.

applicableAreas: Entire site; all areas where construction will occur
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines are present on or adjacent to the site along Valley View Road and northern boundary. Construction activities are proposed including grading, utility installation, building construction, and landscaping. Cover sheet and general notes do not include required note that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003. Add mandatory 48-hour notification requirement note to cover sheet.
